name: evfit_gpfit
expr: pe = evfit(xev1); pg1 = gpfit(xgp1); pg2 = gpfit(xgp2); pg3 = gpfit(xgp3); err_ev_mu = abs(pe(1) - 1.0); err_ev_se = abs(pe(2) - 2.0);
comment: Sig: [muhat, sigmahat] = evfit(x) — Gumbel-min MLE: μ profiled out via Σ exp(x_i/σ)=n; 1-D Newton on σ-equation Σ x_i e^{x_i/σ}/Σ e^{x_i/σ} - mean - σ = 0 (negative-definite f'). [khat, sigmahat] = gpfit(x) — Generalised Pareto MLE: PWM (Hosking-Wallis 1987 α-form) as warm start, then 2-D Newton-Raphson on the GP log-likelihood with central-FD gradient & Hessian, backtracking line search with feasibility guard. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b at ~1e-5 on deterministic inverse-CDF samples (k=0.3, -0.1, 0).
